'''Hapan ale''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage brewed in the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. It also came in a spiced variety.<ref name="heir" />

[[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]] enjoyed the spiced variety with her parents&mdash;[[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]] and [[Teneniel Djo]]&mdash;when she was young and before leaving for [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to start her [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]].<ref name="heir" />
